name: Tidepool Main Stage
description: The big one, facing the bay so the sun sets behind the crowd. Big screens either side and an accessible viewing platform on the left.

name: Lighthouse Stage
description: Under the old Driftwood Point lighthouse. The second stage, and the one people tell their friends about afterwards.

name: Kelp Forest
description: A covered tent hung with 3,000 strips of recycled sailcloth. Electronic sets every night until 12:30 am.

name: Driftwood Stage
description: A small wooden stage in the dunes with hay bales and a view of the water. Bring a blanket.
